notes: Comparison of app's Gaussian-smoothed CC raster (sigma=15 px / 450 m) against InVEST UCM's canonical HMI = max(CC_local, CC_park) with exponential decay near green areas >= 2 ha. Both use the same biophysical table (biophysical_table_urban_cooling_MN.csv) and the same LULC raster (MN baseline, no conversions). InVEST args from invest_urban_cooling_model_args_MN.json: t_ref=23.2, uhi_max=2.05, t_air_average_radius=600, green_area_cooling_distance=450, cc_method=factors. Raw CC comparison isolates biophysical-table differences (should be near-zero); HMI-vs-smoothed-CC comparison isolates the park-proximity divergence (expected to be the main gap). natcap.invest version used: see conda env. Phase 1: one scenario, one city, baseline only.
